mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, enabled, failed_attempts, locked_until, last_login_at FROM admin_users WHERE LOWER(username)=LOWER(#{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_users(username, password_hash, enabled) VALUES(#{username}, #{passwordHash}, true)
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_users SET failed_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL, last_login_at=now(), updated_at=now() WHERE LOWER(username)=LOWER(#{username})

UPDATE admin_users SET failed_attempts=failed_attempts + 1, locked_until=CASE WHEN failed_attempts + 1 >= 5 THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE locked_until END, updated_at=now() WHERE LOWER(username)=LOWER(#{username})
UPDATE admin_users SET password_hash=#{passwordHash}, failed_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL, updated_at=now() WHERE LOWER(username)=LOWER(#{username})
